shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/; git status --short | head -50

cat AGENTS.md; echo ---; cat index.html; echo ---; cat tsconfig.json; echo ---; cat vite.config.ts; echo ---; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50; echo ---; for f in src/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; }; done; echo ---; ls node_modules | head -100; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat .gitignore; echo ---; ls -R .agents | head -60
cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -80
wc -l .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/*.md && sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md
npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version 2>&1 | tail -3; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -20
npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 peerDependenciesMeta dependencies 2>/dev/null; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 engines 2>/dev/null

npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn Unknown env" | tail -20; node -e 'console.log(require("./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json").version)'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components 2>/dev/null | head -80
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -i -A25 "required setup" README.md | head -80; echo ----; wc -l build/docs/INDEX.md; sed -n '1,200p' build/docs/INDEX.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Provider TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button Text Card 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && sed -n '1,200p' components/controls/PasswordInput.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Provider TextInput PasswordInput Checkbox Button Text 2>&1 | head -40; echo ----; D=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs; sed -n '1,200p' $D/components/controls/TextInput.md | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -i "provider" build/docs/guides/theming.md | head -40; echo ----; grep -rn "ThemeProvider" build/index.d.ts build/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls build | head -40; echo ----; grep -n "Provider" README.md | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && sed -n '1,60p' guides/theming.md; echo ----CHECKBOX; sed -n '1,120p' components/Checkbox.md; echo ----BUTTON-PROPS; grep -n -E "^\| (view|size|width|loading|type|disabled|pin|href|onClick)" components/Button.md; echo ----TEXT; grep -n -E "variant|header-|body-" components/Text.md | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -E "^\| (view|size|type|spacing|className|children|anchor)" build/docs/components/Card.md | head; echo ----; f=$(grep -rl "ButtonProps" build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -3); echo "$f"; grep -rn "type?:" $(echo "$f" | head -1) | head -5; echo ----; grep -n "Text" build/docs/components/Text.md | sed -n '1,3p' >/dev/null; grep -n -E "^\| (variant|color|as|ellipsis)" build/docs/components/Text.md; echo ---; grep -n -E "\| (validationState|onUpdate|name|type|value|label) " build/docs/components/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -3; grep -n '^export' build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls build/esm | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls controls/PasswordInput 2>/dev/null; echo ----BUTTON; sed -n '1,80p' Button/Button.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls Button | head

grep -n -B2 -A6 "ButtonButtonProps\b" Button/types.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; grep -n "type?\|onUpdate\|validationState\|name?" controls/TextInput/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls controls/TextInput

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && node -e 'const p=require("./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json"); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.exports["./styles/*"]??p.exports["./styles/fonts.css"]??Object.keys(p.exports).filter(k=>k.includes("styles")), null, 1))'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/styles 2>/dev/null | head; node -e 'console.log("tsc", require("./node_modules/typescript/package.json").version)'; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && node -e 'const p=require("./package.json"); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.exports["./styles/*"]))'; ls build/styles 2>/dev/null; ls styles 2>/dev/null; find . -name "styles.css" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && sed -n '1,60p' components/Card/Card.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls components/Card; echo ----TEXT; grep -n "as\|htmlFor\|TextProps" components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -20; ls components/Text; echo ----FLEX; grep -rn "direction\|gap" components/Flex/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8; ls components/Flex 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout && ls; grep -n -E "direction|gap|alignItems|spacing|width|interface|type " *.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; grep -rn "spacing" Box/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides && grep -n -i -E "flex|direction|spacing|padding|paddingInline|\bp=|Card" layout.md | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout && sed -n '108,137p' types.d.ts; grep -n -E "direction|flexDirection|wrap" types.d.ts Flex/*.d.ts | head -10; echo ---; sed -n '1,40p' Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -40
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components && grep -n -i "padding\|spacing" Card.md | head -12
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40
rm -rf dist && cat package.json | sed -n '10,20p' && git status --short && git diff --stat
